result.title: Layer-Matched Sparse Attention for Low-Redundancy 3D Reconstruction
result.summary: VGGT reconstructs cameras and geometry from unposed images in one pass, but its global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. Training-free accelerators thin this attention and work well on redundant video, but lose pose accuracy when views share little geometry. This paper traces these losses to two kinds of cross-view information that a uniform sparse approximation can fail to preserve together: diffuse layers aggregate distributed context, whereas matching layers depend on query-specific interactions that carry little attention mass. A per-layer statistic measures the log-mass missed by a mean token. Its row-free proxy is the logit variance, and it selects the estimator for each layer. Diffuse layers use shared, importance-sampled hub keys, with log-weights that make the softmax numerator and denominator unbiased. Matching layers stay exact: every aggressive thinning tested cost accuracy. At equal cost, the selected layers outperform the four shifted windows tested. On 13 unseen low-redundancy scenes with 32 views, LMSA stays within 1.4 AUC@5 of dense attention, compared with 10.3 for AVGGT and 4.5 for SAF3R; its difference from contemporaneous GPA-VGGT is not significant, and only its gains over AVGGT pass both scene-level tests. With 100 views, it stays within 1.9 AUC@5 while its aggregator runs $2.0\times$ faster. Used post hoc to choose the layers GPA-VGGT protects, the statistic improves it by 1.2 AUC@5 for 5% more FLOPs. Applied untuned to $π^3$, it beats AVGGT but remains further from dense accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 VGGT 多视图全局注意力的训练无关稀疏加速：提出逐层统计量（以 logit 方差为免行归一化代理）区分聚合分散上下文的弥散层与依赖查询特异交互的匹配层，只对弥散层用重要性采样的共享 hub keys 加无偏对数权重，匹配层保持精确，以在低冗余视角下维持位姿精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐层注意力质量分布与「哪些层可压缩、哪些须保留精确交互」的判别线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、token 剪枝与 latent 缓存/深度差异的取舍，但属 3D 重建加速，迁移性需核查。
